design.note: offline only; full clock; factorial base-position assignments x basic movement policy x seeds; no autonomous skill/augment/retreat/formation selection; production values unchanged

economy.assumptions: one original player, both original squads retained; one uncontested owned home point throughout; no damage/capture/spending. Job lower bound ignores rank/income waits.

augments.selectionPolicy: first three eligible unselected IDs sorted lexically; seed does not randomize offers

reportAnnotation: Clock/layout annotations added from invocation; authoritative replay hashes unchanged.
